instruction: Change the font size of the first paragraph in the tutorial guidelines to 14pt to emphasize it.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the font size of the entire first paragraph to 14 points. The evaluator extracts font size information from all text runs in the first non-empty paragraph and checks if (1) ALL runs have the same font size (uniform) AND (2) that font size matches 14pt within a tolerance of 0.5pt. Returns 1.0 if both conditions are met, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction requires changing font size of 'entire first paragraph' to 14pt - evaluator correctly verifies this requirement
Getter extracts all font sizes from runs in first paragraph and calculates 'all_runs_same_size' flag (docx_getter.py:75)
Metric correctly checks TWO conditions (docx_metric.py:30-31, 34): (1) all_runs_same_size == True (ensures uniformity) AND (2) predominant_size matches target within tolerance
This logic ensures ENTIRE paragraph has uniform font size of 14pt, not just majority - semantically correct
Postconfig includes save operation (Ctrl+S) to ensure DOCX file is saved before evaluation
Edge case handling: Returns 0.0 when predominant_size is None (no explicit font size set) or when runs have mixed sizes
